scientific_intent.scientific_task: Partition an undirected CSR graph into connected components with each vertex labeled by the minimum vertex ID in its component.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Connected-component equivalence closure of undirected adjacency; concurrent decreasing-root linking with CAS and pointer compression, followed by root flattening.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Unweighted undirected sparse CSR adjacency; 0-based source vertex IDs retained.
invariants: All parent IDs stay in same independent BFS component and do not exceed own vertex ID.
Final label equals component minimum; labels agree across every edge and isolated vertices retain own ID.
CSR input remains byte-exact and all array guard regions remain unchanged.
accuracy_requirements: Exact Int32 labels/input/guards; zero numerical tolerance; no floating computation.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Integer indexing/CAS correctness, not floating roundoff; counter/index bounds must remain valid.
